name: Golden Cassia
desc: Golden Cassia (Chamaecrista fasciculata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Chamaecrista fasciculata, the partridge pea, is a species of legume native to most of the eastern United States. It is an annual which grows to approximately 0.5 meters (1 ft 8 in) tall.
